units.source_text: 且说住在这里面的末摘花，只因近来连日阴雨，心情越发不佳，镇日垂头丧气地枯坐着。

en.t: Now, Lady Suetsumuhana, who lived there, had been feeling worse and worse because of the recent days of continuous rain, and sat there all day in low spirits, her head drooping.

units.source_text: 今天昼寝时做一个梦，看见已故的父亲常陆亲王，醒后更加悲伤了。

en.t: Today, during her afternoon nap, she had a dream in which she saw her late father, Prince Hitachi, and after waking she felt even more sorrowful.

units.source_text: 便命老侍女将漏湿的檐前揩拭干净，整理一下各处的坐具，

en.t: So she ordered an old lady-in-waiting to wipe clean the eaveside area that had grown damp from leaks, and to tidy the cushions and seats here and there,

units.source_text: 暂时打叠平日的忧思，像常人一样悠然地在檐前坐憩一会，独自吟诗道：

en.t: then for a little while she put aside her usual worries, sat at ease by the eaves like an ordinary person, rested for a moment, and recited a poem to herself:
